The problem In finance, bringing an investment product from concept to client involves a long chain of specialised teams; from product design and portfolio management to risk, compliance, marketing, and distribution, each using different tools and terminologies. This results in a fragmented ecosystem where information flows slowly and is often inconsistent. Without a shared infrastructure, departments maintain separate versions of data and processes, creating digital silos and operational friction. And while AI tools hold promise, they often add complexity; layering new models and tools on top of an already overloaded stack, rather than simplifying it.
